text:
Aisha: Quick props to Carlos & Lina for saving the all-hands demo yesterday — they found the bad env var and balanced the AV setup. Cookies on me next week! :tada:
Ben: Absolutely, those logs were a lifesaver. Carlos nailed the `env-check` trick. :raised_hands:
Carlos: Team effort! Shoutout to Maya for the last-minute slide cleanup too. @Maya you rock. :star:
Lina: Couldn't have done it without the coffee stash in pantry. Also big thanks to Facilities for restocking kombucha. :sparkling_heart:
Maya: Aww thanks! Happy to tidy decks anytime. Also thanks to @Remy (ops-bot) for auto-assigning the AV ticket. :robot_face:
Remy (ops-bot): AV ticket #342 assigned to Carlos, resolved in 14m. System note: pantry snack box restocked with GF cookies and pretzels. :package:
Aisha: Also nominating Carlos for this week's 'Pantry MVP' — tiny virtual trophy incoming. :trophy:
Ben: Vote: Which snack for next week? 1) Sourdough crisps 2) Salted caramel bars 3) More kombucha
Lina: 2 for salted caramel!
Maya: 3 for kombucha from me :upside_down_face:
Carlos: I'll accept the trophy and the cookie tax. Thanks y'all. :blush:
Aisha: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheers-teamwork-3o6vXT8X7w2cQ (posted)
Ben: :clap: :clap: :clap: Good vibes all around — can we add a sticky note on the AV rack with the `env-check` snippet?
Carlos: Will do. Pasting it here: `if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ENV" ]; then echo "set REDWOOD_ENV=prod"; fi` (for the record)
Maya: Love this. Carrying the momentum — thanks everyone! :heart:
